name: snapper-mcp-local
description: Local-build Snapper MCP bridge pointing at localhost:8000. Uses the in-repo dist (integrations/snapper-mcp/dist/index.js) so changes to bridge source apply after `npm run build`. Reads credentials from data/dev-pat.json — mint via `snapper dev-mint-pat`. Rendered by `make local-plugin` — do not edit the rendered copy in data/.
